_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. The two goals (spec section 9). launch: the launch point, Planet 1's ending: every listed district at `stage`. A district's value is stage_values[its stage] plus the step to the next value times how far it is toward the next stage (share of hexes at the next stage or above, over districts.json stage_share); the city readout is the mean over the districts. planet: the long goal after the launch point, never required: measure and named steps as in the spec; open_ground_hex_work = units of work the simulator assumes for a hex outside the cities; finish_in_hours = for each number of further bot hours, the report says how many robots finishing the whole planet in that time would take (cleaning only, at the launch-point rate per robot).
